coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: The output identifies EM and MinED as alternative criteria, matching one of the three ground-truth variable items. It does not identify BBH as the fixed benchmark or average score across its 27 tasks as the dependent variable.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output focuses on reward-formulation refinements and synthetic sanity checks rather than the specified experimental design. It omits the BBH benchmark and the required aggregate performance metric; references to unchanged sections do not supply these missing details.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: The output fails to state that minimum-edit-distance-based MinED consistently outperforms the exact-matching EM method introduced by Fu et al. (2023).
